comments.text:
Test coverage for this bug (manual QA, local env http://localhost:3000, 2026-10-12). Case files are kept in the QA repository under tasks/; this comment only references them.

*UI cases that fail because of this bug* (suite cart-and-cancellation, run RUN-2026-10-12-001)
* TC-006 Reject quantity 0 when adding to cart: FAIL. Control shows 1, Add to Cart adds 1 copy, toast "Book added to cart".
* TC-011 Reject quantity -1 when adding to cart: FAIL. Same behaviour (-1 becomes 1, one copy added).
* TC-012 Reject quantity 1.5 when adding to cart: FAIL. Same behaviour (1.5 becomes 1, one copy added).

*API cases that show the server side is fine* (suite cart-api, run RUN-2026-10-12-002, POST /api/cart as guest)
* TC-001 quantity 0, TC-002 quantity -1, TC-003 quantity 1.5, TC-004 quantity "abc", TC-005 quantity missing: all PASS with 400 VALIDATION\_ERROR.
* TC-006 quantity above stock: PASS with 400 INSUFFICIENT\_STOCK.
* TC-007 unknown book: PASS with 404 BOOK\_NOT\_FOUND.
* TC-008 valid quantity 1: PASS with 201 (positive control).

*What this means*
The server validation from REF-29 works. The problem is in the UI: the Quantity field turns an invalid value into 1 before the request is sent, so the server check is never reached and 1 copy is added silently. The issue is not limited to quantity 0; -1 and 1.5 behave the same way.

Reports: reports/RUN-2026-10-12-001.md (UI), reports/RUN-2026-10-12-002.md (API).

description:
*Found by:* manual test TC-006 (run RUN-2026-10-09-001), confirmed by the tester on 2026-10-09.
*Environment:* http://localhost:3000, local disposable env (Docker Postgres, seed data), regular user.
*Related:* REF-10, REF-29.

*Steps to reproduce*
# Log in as the regular user and make sure the cart is empty.
# Open /books/3 (1984, in stock).
# Type 0 into the "Quantity" field.
# Click "Add to Cart".
# Open /cart.

*Expected:* quantity must be a whole number from 1 up to stock (REF-29). A quantity of 0 is rejected with a clear message and nothing is added.

*Actual:* the add succeeds. A "Book added to cart" toast appears, the nav cart badge shows 1, the quantity field reverts to 1, and /cart lists one "1984" line with quantity 1 and subtotal $13.99. No console errors.

*Notes*
* The UI appears to coerce 0 to 1 before calling /api/cart, so the server-side validation from the REF-29 fix is not reached for this input.
* Not yet tested: -1, 1.5, and a direct POST /api/cart with invalid quantities.

title: Add to cart: quantity 0 on the book page is added to the cart as 1 instead of being rejected
